image_description: A male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) perched on a thin, mossy branch. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage: black head and throat, bright orange-rufous breast, white belly, and black upperparts with distinct white wing bars and shoulder patches. The background consists of out-of-focus branches and sky.
